constraints.description: Filesystem cold reload and its write boundary preserve the fs-skills versus api discriminator, stale dynamic copies cannot override real configuration sources, and reconciliation never selects api, builtin, or wasm records.

validation.validation_method: Cold-reload provenance assertion, rejected non-API write, stale-copy precedence assertion, real API creation assertion, and observed-failing boundary, precedence, and provider-filter inversions

constraints.description: Configuration add, change, removal tombstone, and restoration survive separate-process SurrealKV reopen; tombstones remain durable but are absent from default, refresh, keyword, vector, and matching views; restoration preserves scoped configuration.

validation.validation_method: Four-child cold-process test plus domain, registry, refresh, vector-limit, matching, attributable-log assertions, and observed-failing visibility inversions

constraints.description: A zero-skill configuration source cannot tombstone a durable configuration catalogue, and removing the guard makes its exact test fail.

validation.validation_method: Positive fail-safe assertion, observed exit-101 inversion, and exact pre/post source hashes

constraints.description: Tier 0, focused server-full tests, strict OpenSpec validation, formatting, and permitted-surface inspection pass while phase Tier 2 remains unrun.

validation.validation_method: Cargo check/clippy/tests, OpenSpec strict validation, artifact schema replay, and scoped diff inspection

global_rules: Use the B5 OpenSpec delta and EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md as acceptance authority.
Report results only for server-full and transfer them to no other profile.
Reconciliation tombstones and restores; it never hard-deletes.
Do not run Tier 2 before the final B5 artifact review and commit.
termination_conditions: The per-requirement verification record retains literal output for all six observed-failing controls.
